answer_1.quote: SpeechT5 can support generation tasks such as speech translation and voice conversion.

answer_2.quote: Translation results are evaluated with case-sensitive BLEU. We evaluate the Naturalness with the open-source NISQA-TTS, the mean opinion score (MOS), and the comparison mean opinion score (CMOS) by native speakers.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the Naturalness with the open-source NISQA-TTS, the mean option score (MOS), and the comparison mean option score (CMOS) by native speakers on the randomly selected 200 sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Native speakers listened to the generated speech and rated its naturalness using MOS and CMOS scales.
